title: ChestSortLite
description: 🧰 One-command chest and inventory sorter with stack merge support.
body:
# 🧰 ChestSortLite

Sort inventories and containers instantly with one command.

## ✨ Features
- `/sort chest` for open container sorting
- `/sort inv` for player inventory sorting
- Optional stack merge support
- Configurable default sort target
- Fast, safe, and dependency-free

## 🧩 Commands
- `/sort`
- `/sort chest`
- `/sort inv`
- `/sort reload`

## ✅ Requirements
- Java 17+
- Paper/Spigot/Purpur/Folia/Bukkit
- Minecraft 1.20+

## ☕ Support
- https://buymeacoffee.com/perusi
